Font, extra keys, bell, keep screen on
Needs you, done, live card, lock screen
Keys and certificates Herdline signs in with
Scales menus, buttons and the switcher. The terminal keeps its own font size.
Tints the app and every session. Without a choice, a session wears its node\'s colour.
Overrides the wallpaper\'s colour. Choose “Each node\'s colour” to follow it.
Auto keeps Herdr\'s sidebar beside the terminal when the window is at least 840 dp wide and 480 dp tall. Its ‹ button folds it to a rail of workspaces.
The Tabs sheet and sidebar open on this filter each time, and Agents when it opens. Tapping a chip there changes only that open list.

Only the Tabs sheet and sidebar hide rows, and a line under the list shows how many, with Show. Search still finds them. A tab that needs you is never hidden. The phone tab row, Tabs n/N, Agents and notifications always count every tab.
Off, the terminal asks the keyboard for plain keys. On, it offers words and corrections; a picked correction replaces its word in the pane. The composer always has them.
Enabled keys appear in this order. The arrow moves a key one place earlier.
Quiet, and only while Herdline is in the background.
Pin an agent from its ⋮ menu in the switcher or the session menu. Samsung decides whether Live Updates appear in the Now Bar.
Chosen when you pin a live update. Alert and done notifications keep the setting above.
No live update now: no pinned agent is working.
Not connected: not shown as live
This Android version shows an ordinary notification instead
Live Updates are off for Herdline
Ordinary ongoing notification: Android reports it does not qualify as a Live Update.
Requested; Android or Samsung hasn\'t promoted it
Names adds the host, the agent and its status; Full adds titles and messages.
Locked, an agent that finishes shows as:

Herdline includes three launcher icon variants. The home screen switches to the one you pick. Some launchers take a moment, and may move or remove a home-screen shortcut. Custom icons and pinned shortcuts are not available yet.
Preview of the session with the current settings
Colours from your wallpaper. Status colours and the terminal stay fixed.
Mode, colour theme, terminal schemes, interface size, density, accent and launcher icon variant go back to their defaults. Language stays. Nodes, keys and drafts stay.
Font, font size, vibrate on bell, keep screen on and the extra keys go back to their defaults. Imported and downloaded fonts stay. Nodes, keys and drafts stay.
Keyboard suggestions in the terminal go back to off. Nodes, keys and drafts stay.
Session layout, the open or folded sidebar, tab order, the start filter, both hide toggles and every control on the Controls page go back to their defaults. Pins stay. Nodes, keys and drafts stay.
Every + menu entry and Tabs list section comes back, in the original order. Nodes, keys and drafts stay.
Every notification and the live card go back on, and the lock screen goes back to Hidden. Android\'s own notification settings stay. Nodes, keys and drafts stay.
Appearance, terminal and extra keys, composer, layout with the Tabs list and controls, notifications and lock screen. Language, nodes, keys and drafts stay.
Reset every setting on this screen to its default?
Keeps Insert without Enter reachable. Show the other one first to hide this.
While hidden, the Tabs list always shows All.
Send, Chat | Terminal, Search and the order selector are always shown. Insert without Enter stays in the + menu or inside the larger editor.
Checking the pane before Send: it is still resizing…
The agent is working, so Send is off until it is idle. Steer pastes your text, then presses Enter once; if the turn ends just before, the text starts a new turn.
Steering: pasting your text, then one Enter…
The steer stopped before Enter: your text is in the pane\'s input box
The agent is idle: use Send
The steer was not finished: check the pane
Waiting for the pane to show the text…
